Perfect! ✅ Your **Pebble Remote** design has been successfully migrated to the new format. 

**Summary of changes:**
- ✅ Converted `button_outline` (polygon format) → `button_shape` (CSG format)
- ✅ Power button: circular shape (ellipse, radius 8)
- ✅ Volume & channel buttons: rectangular shapes (16×14mm, rounded corners)
- ✅ All other structure (shape, enclosure, IR LED) preserved exactly
- ✅ Design validates successfully

The design is ready to manufacture. The IR LED is positioned on the top edge for side-mounting, and all five buttons are placed intuitively for handheld operation.
